content: Yesuusi Kiitteedda Tammanne Laa77u Asatuwaabaa
Yesuusi bare tammanne laa77u kaalliyawantta xeesiide, unttunttu iita ayyaanaa kessana mala, qassi harggiyaa ubbaanne sakuwaa ubbaa pathana mala, unttunttoo maataa immeedda.
Yesuusi kiitteedda tammanne laa77atuwaa sunthay, koyrowe Phexiroosa geetettiyaa Simoonanne A ishaa Inddiraasa, Zabiddiyoosa naanaa, Yayiqoobanne Yohaannisa,
Piliphphoosa, Barttalamoosa, Toomaasa, qaraxaa akkiya Maatoossa, Ilppiyoosa na7aa Yayiqoobanne Taadoosa;
bare gadew qarettiyaa Simoonanne Yesuusa aathi immeedda Asqqorootu Yihudaa.
Yesuusi Kiitteedda Tammanne Laa77atuu Tamaarissanaw Kiitetteeddino
Yesuusi ha tammanne laa77atuwaa hawaadan yaagiide kiitteedda; “Ayihuda gidenna asaa gadiyaa booppite; qassi Samaaretuwaa katamaakka geloppite;
hewaa diraa bayeedda dorssaakko, Isra7eeliya asaakko
biide, ‘Saluwaa kawutethay mateedda’ yaagiide odite.
Hargganchchatuwaa pathite; anhaa hayquwaappe denthite; oolluu oyqqeeddawantta pathite; iita ayyanatuwakka kessite. Hinttenttu coo akkeeddita; coo immite.
Worqqaa woy biraa woy santtimiyaa hinttenttu kiisiyan oyqqoppite;
woy ogew qarcciitiyaa, woy laa7ethiyaa mayuwaa, woy caammaa woy xam77aa oyqqoppite. Ayissi gooppe, oosanchchaw koshshiyaabay qumaa.
“Hinttenttu geliyaa katamaan woy qeeri katamaa ubbaan hinttena mokkanaw nashettiyaawe oonentto akeekan xomoosite; hinttenttu hewaappe kesana gakkanaw, hewaan uttite.
Qassi golle geliidde sarotite.
He gollen de7iyaa asay hinttena mokkooppe, hinttenttu saroteedda sarotay unttuntta gakko. Shin unttunttu hinttena mokkennaan ixxooppe, hinttenttu saroteedda sarotay hinttew guyye simmo.
Qassi itti itti golli woy katamay hinttena mokkennaan woy hinttenttu odiyaawaa sisennaan ixxooppe, he golleppe woy he katamaappe kesiidde, hinttenttu gediyaappe baanaa shocite.
Taani hinttew tumuwaa oday; Xoossay pirddiyaa gallassi he katamaa asaappe, Sodoomaa katamaa asawunne Gamooraa katamaa asaw pirddaa kawushissana.
Goday Yaanaappe Kasetiide, Yederssuunne Metuu Hanana
“Be7ite! Taani hinttena dorssaa wallatuwaa giddo yeddiyaawaadan yedday. Hewaa diraw, shooshshaadan cincca gidite; qassi haraphphiyaadan, ashikke gidite.
Shin asaappe naagettite. Ayissi gooppe, asay hinttena pirdda gollew aathiide immana; qassi bare Ayihuda woosa golletuwaanikka hinttena lissuwan peeddana.
Gadiyaa ayissiyaawanttu sinthaaninne kaatatuwaa sinthaan ta diraw hinttenttu eqqiide, unttunttussinne Ayihuda gidenna asaa sinthaan taw markka gidanita.
Shin unttunttu hinttena pirddaw aathiyaa wode, hinttenttu haasayanabaa he saatiyaan Xoossay hinttew immiya diraw, hinttenttu gaanabawunne woy waagiide haasayanenttonne hirggoppite.
Ayissi gooppe, hinttenttun aqiide haasayiyaawe hinttenttu Aawuuwaa Geeshsha Ayyaanaappe attin, haasayiyaawanttu hinttentta gidikkita.
“Ishay bare ishaa, aawuu bare na7aa bolla denddana; naanay barenttu aattinne aawuwaa bolla denddiide, unttuntta wodhissana.
Qassi asay ubbay hinttentta ta sunthaa diraw ixxana; shin wursethay gakkanaw gencciyaawe attanawaa.

Unttunttu hinttena itti katamaappe yederssooppe, hara katamaa biite. Ayissi gooppe, taani hinttew tumuwaa gay; taani, Asaa Na7ay, yaana gakkanaw, hinttenttu hintte oosuwaa Isra7eeliyaa katamaa ubbaan oothiide wurssikkita.
“Tamaariyaawe barena tamaarissiyaawaappe darenna; qoomaykka bare godaappe darenna.
Tamaariyaawe barena tamaarissiyaawaa keena gidiyaawe, qoomaykka bare godaa keena gidiyaawe aw gidana; unttunttu golle godaa Bi7eel-Zeebula giide xeesooppe, A golle asaa waagi xeesaneeshsha!
Oossi Yayyanaw Bessintto
“Simmi asaassi yayyoppite; ayissi gooppe, genthi wotheeddabay qoncciyaa kesennaan attenna; qoseeddabaykka erettennaan attenna.
Taani hinttenttoo dhumaani odiyaabaa poo7uwan haasayite; hinttew haythaan saasukkiide odeeddawaa, dhoqqa saan awaayyite.
Ashuwaa wodhiyaawanttoo yayyoppite; unttunttu, shemppuwaa wodhanaw danddaykkino. Shin shemppuwaanne ashuwaa Gaannamiyan dhayissanaw danddayiyaa Xoossaassi yayyite.
Laa77u suunniyaa kafatuu santtimiyaan zali77ettikkinoo? Hinttenttu Aawuuwaa sheniyaa gidana dhayooppe, he suunniyaa kafatuwaappe ittinnakka sa7aan wodhdhaade bayukku.
Shin haray atto, hinttenttu huuphiyan de7iyaa binnanay ubbaykka payduwaan de7ee.
Simmi yayyoppite; daro suunniyaa kafatuwaappe hinttenttu aadhdhiita.
Kiristtoosabaa Markkattanaw Bessee
“Hewaa diraw, asaa sinthaan tabaa markkattiyaa oossi gidooppenne, taanikka saluwan de7iya ta Aabbu sinthan markkattana;
shin asaa sinthaan taana kaddiyaa oonanne taanikka qassi saluwan de7iya ta Aabbu sinthaan A kaddana.
“Taani sa7aassi sarotethaa ahanaw yeeddawaa hinttessi malatoppo; taani tooraa ahanaw yeeddawaappe attin, sarotethaa ahanaw yabeykke.
Ayissi gooppe, taani na7aa A aabbuppe, naatto izi daayippe, na7aa machchattokka izi bollotattippe shaakkanaw yaaddi;
asaassi morkketuu A golle asatuwaa gidanawantta.
“Bare aabba woy bare daayo taappe aathiide siiqiyaawe tawaa gidanaw bessenna; bare attuma na7aa woy bare macca naatto taappe aathiide siiqiyaawe tawaa gidanaw bessenna.
Bare masqqaliyaa tookkiide, ta geeduwaa kaallennawe tawaa gidanaw bessenna.
Bare shemppuwaa ashshiyaawe bayizzanawaa; shin ta diraw bare shemppuwaa bayizziyaawe ashshanawaa.
“Hinttentta mokkiyaawe taana mokkee; qassi taana mokkiyaawe taana kiitteeddawaa mokkee.
Nabiyaa, nabiyaa sunthaan mokkiyaawe, nabiyaa gatiyaa aananna gishettanawaa; qassi xilluwaa, xilluwaa sunthaan mokkiyaawe, xilluwaa gatiyaa aananna gishettanawaa.
Ooninne ha taana kaalliyaawanttuppe guuxxiyaa ittoo, haray atto buliyaa haathaa xalalaa ushanaw immooppekka, taani hinttenttoo tumuwaa gay; I bare gatiyaa akkana” yaageedda.
